_comment: Copy this to scripts/roster.json and fill in the real org.
roster.json is GITIGNORED on purpose: this repository is public, and a
real corporate directory (names + working email addresses) is exactly
what gets scraped for phishing. Never commit the real file.
team: business | product | tech_spoc | development | design | qa | partner | leadership
role: member | lead | pmo | leadership | svp  (defaults to 'member' if omitted)
email: must be unique. The schema enforces it, and auth lowercases it.
department: optional, purely descriptive (shown in the UI, not used for
managerEmail: optional. Resolved to manager_id in a second pass after
every row exists, so a manager listed later in the file (or already in
the database) still resolves correctly. Drives subtree-based project
seesAllProjects: optional boolean, default false. An explicit, named
'sees every project' grant — data-driven, not a hierarchy derivation.
